notes.title: Release Date Reveal & New Demo
notes.notes:
[p][i]Ayo![/i][/p][p][i]You read the title, you clicked “Read more” you know what time it is. Hope you brought your headphones![/i][/p][previewyoutube="MbAbLddvyuc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]We’re beyond excited to announce that Eclipsium will finally launch on Steam on September 19th! That’s less than a month from now and, to be honest, that’s equal parts exciting and terrifying. It’s our first game as a studio, and, frankly, the release date is a pants shitting level event.[/i][/p][p][i]Here’s what we’ve cooked up for you:[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]A layered story through a nightmare-fueled world, that we’ve infused with as much emotional weight as we possibly can.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fantastical body horror that will hopefully make you squint your eyes a little. And maybe say “Ew!”. But, it’s tasteful also.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unique handcrafted locations—church like slaughterhouses, cursed forests, at some point you’re falling in a neverending, repeating space![/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Visuals have gotten a glowup—we have honed and refined the art style that defines Eclipsium, while minimizing pesky head aches.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Over 20 tracks of custom-written, intense songs to go with the dreamlike visuals. Each one a banger.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/7bc408f05210589f3bb38e3546168c03a6651180.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]
But, don’t take our word for it-you can experience a slice of it for yourself: we just dropped a new demo![/i][/p][p][i]What are you still doing here? Try it out right this instant.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419670/Eclipsium/"][/dynamiclink][i]Please let us know what you think about it!
[/i][/p][p][i]And if you’re looking for other games to tickle your nerves, take a look at [b]Carimara: Beneath the forlorn limbs[/b] – a creepy whimsy about asking the right questions to the weird inhabitants of its grove. Are you willing to lay your head in order to realise someone else’s wish?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570370/CARIMARA_Beneath_the_forlorn_limbs/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i]‘til next time![/i][/p][p][i]Housefire Games & CRITICAL REFLEX[/i][/p]
